Weekends: Both sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day.

Inference:
Nora left for work at 08:00 (took phone, keys, jacket, shoes, dog leash). She returned at 12:00 (items reappeared in entry/bedroom). She was home sick for the rest of the day, moving items to the living room (laptop, book, mug) for rest/reading.
Yuki was home all day. At 08:00, Yuki’s phone was taken out (likely for lunch/errand) and returned by 12:00. Yuki moved their mug and water bottle between desk and kitchen throughout the day.
The dog leash was taken out at 08:00 and returned at 12:00, suggesting a midday walk.
Both residents are home at 23:59.
